layout_sources: https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf [PL PKO BP] (file history_csv_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv; comma; quoted header "Data operacji","Data waluty","Typ transakcji","Kwota","Waluta",...,"Opis transakcji","","","",""; dates "2023-06-07"; 10 input columns with the amount 4th and the description split over the trailing columns)

iPKO history exports as widely quoted by Polish budgeting tools: a "Saldo po transakcji" column after Waluta, amounts and balances with a point decimal and an explicit + on money in, and the description spread over several "Label: value" cells (Tytuł, Lokalizacja, Nazwa nadawcy/odbiorcy, Numer karty ...). From memory.
notes: iPKO "Historia rachunku" CSV. Comma-separated, every field double-quoted, Windows-1250 (Polish letters as one byte), CRLF. Dates YYYY-MM-DD; Kwota and "Saldo po transakcji" signed with a point decimal, no thousands mark, a + on money in and on positive balances. The header names one "Opis transakcji" column followed by empty-named ones; each line carries as many description cells as it has (4 or 5 here), so lines are not all as long as the header. Newest first. Expected dates are "Data operacji"; the card line's purchase day is in its "Data wykonania operacji" cell. Closing = the newest balance; opening = the oldest balance minus its amount. bank2ynab's header comment omits "Saldo po transakcji" but its column count matches a file that has it.
